test_cases.description: Campaign store enforces that status must be one of pending, active, completed, failed, or cancelled via a CHECK constraint, rejecting any other value.
preconditions: SQLite in-memory database is initialized with the campaigns table via InitSchema
A valid campaigns row exists for insertion
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: err = db.Exec("INSERT INTO campaigns (id, workspace_slug, name, integration_branch, status, dag, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", uuid, 'ws', 'camp', 'main', 'running', '{}', 'user', now, now); assert err != nil; assert err.Error() contains 'CHECK constraint failed'

test_cases.description: POST /campaigns returns HTTP 201 with status=active in the response body, confirming the campaign is synchronously activated before the response is returned.
preconditions: Hub is running with SQLite in-memory DB
Workspace 'ws-slug' exists
Integration branch 'main' exists in the workspace git repo
No active campaign exists for 'ws-slug'/'main'
Valid tasks.json files exist for spec '07' and '08' with pending subtasks
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = client.post('/api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns', {name: 'sprint-42', spec_ids: ['07','08'], integration_branch: 'main'}); assert resp.status == 201; assert resp.body.status == 'active'; assert resp.body.name == 'sprint-42'

test_cases.description: Campaign scheduler transitions campaign status to completed when all specs in the campaign reach merged status.
preconditions: SQLite in-memory DB initialized with campaigns and campaign_specs tables
Campaign with id='camp-1' exists with status=active
campaign_specs rows for 'camp-1' have spec_ids '07' and '08' both with status=active
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: store.UpdateSpecStatus(ctx, 'camp-1', '07', 'merged'); store.UpdateSpecStatus(ctx, 'camp-1', '08', 'merged'); scheduler.CheckCompletion(ctx, 'camp-1'); campaign = store.GetCampaign(ctx, 'camp-1'); assert campaign.Status == 'completed'

test_cases.description: Campaign scheduler immediately transitions campaign status to failed when any single spec reaches terminal failed status.
preconditions: SQLite in-memory DB initialized
Campaign 'camp-1' with status=active
campaign_specs rows for 'camp-1': spec '07' status=active, spec '08' status=active
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: scheduler.PropagateSpecFailure(ctx, 'camp-1', '07'); campaign = store.GetCampaign(ctx, 'camp-1'); assert campaign.Status == 'failed'

test_cases.description: DELETE /campaigns/:id sets campaign status to cancelled and all campaign_specs statuses to cancelled, leaving spec branches in place.
preconditions: Hub running with SQLite in-memory DB
Campaign 'camp-1' with status=active exists for workspace 'ws-slug'
campaign_specs rows for 'camp-1': spec '07' status=active with branch_name='spec/07-secrets-variables'
Spec branch 'spec/07-secrets-variables' exists in the git repo
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = client.delete('/api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns/camp-1'); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body.status == 'cancelled'; specs = store.GetCampaignSpecs(ctx, 'camp-1'); for spec in specs { assert spec.Status == 'cancelled' }; assert gitRunner.BranchExists('spec/07-secrets-variables') == true

test_cases.description: POST /campaigns returns HTTP 409 when a campaign already exists in active status for the same workspace/integration_branch combination.
preconditions: Hub running with SQLite in-memory DB
Campaign 'camp-existing' with status=active exists for workspace 'ws-slug' and integration_branch='main'

body.error: active campaign already exists for this integration branch

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = client.post('/api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns', {name: 'sprint-43', spec_ids: ['09'], integration_branch: 'main'}); assert resp.status == 409; assert resp.body.error contains 'active campaign'

test_cases.description: The campaigns table enforces UNIQUE(workspace_slug, name) across all statuses, preventing duplicate campaign names within a workspace.
preconditions: SQLite in-memory DB initialized with campaigns table
Campaign row with workspace_slug='ws-slug' and name='sprint-42' and status='completed' already exists
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: err = db.Exec("INSERT INTO campaigns (id, workspace_slug, name, integration_branch, status, dag, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", newUUID, 'ws-slug', 'sprint-42', 'main', 'active', '{}', 'user', now, now); assert err != nil; assert err.Error() contains 'UNIQUE constraint failed'

test_cases.description: POST /campaigns returns HTTP 409 when the campaign name already exists in the workspace, regardless of the existing campaign's status.
preconditions: Hub running with SQLite in-memory DB
Campaign 'sprint-42' with status=completed exists for workspace 'ws-slug'

body.error: campaign name already exists in this workspace

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = client.post('/api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns', {name: 'sprint-42', spec_ids: ['07'], integration_branch: 'feature-branch'}); assert resp.status == 409; assert resp.body.error contains 'name'

test_cases.description: DAG builder reads the dependencies array from each spec's tasks.json and builds a directed graph with spec IDs as vertices and dependency relationships as edges.
preconditions: tasks.json for spec '09' contains dependency entry {depends_on_spec: '07', from_group: 3, to_group: 1, relationship: 'Uses secrets Store', sentinel: false}
tasks.json for spec '07' has no dependencies
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: dag, err = BuildDAG(ctx, ['07', '09'], tasksReader); assert err == nil; assert len(dag.Specs) == 2; assert len(dag.Edges) == 1; assert dag.Edges[0].From == '07'; assert dag.Edges[0].To == '09'; assert dag.Edges[0].Relationship == 'Uses secrets Store'

test_cases.description: DAG builder detects a cycle in spec dependencies and returns HTTP 422 with an error describing the cycle.
preconditions: tasks.json for spec '07' has dependency on spec '09'
tasks.json for spec '09' has dependency on spec '07'

expected.error: cycle detected in spec dependency graph

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: dag, err = BuildDAG(ctx, ['07', '09'], tasksReader); assert err != nil; assert err.Error() contains 'cycle'; resp = client.post('/api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns', {name: 'cyclic', spec_ids: ['07','09'], integration_branch: 'main'}); assert resp.status == 422; assert resp.body.error contains 'cycle'

test_cases.description: DAG builder treats dependency entries referencing specs outside the campaign as pre-satisfied, not as an error.
preconditions: tasks.json for spec '09' has dependency on spec '05' which is not in the campaign
Spec '05' is not included in the spec_ids list
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: dag, err = BuildDAG(ctx, ['09'], tasksReader); assert err == nil; frontier = ComputeFrontier(dag, {}); assert '09' in frontier

test_cases.description: DAG builder stores only spec-level edges (from, to, relationship) in the dag column and discards from_group, to_group, and sentinel fields.
preconditions: tasks.json for spec '09' contains {depends_on_spec: '07', from_group: 3, to_group: 1, relationship: 'Uses secrets', sentinel: true}
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: dag, err = BuildDAG(ctx, ['07','09'], tasksReader); assert err == nil; dagJSON = SerializeDAG(dag); assert dagJSON does not contain 'from_group'; assert dagJSON does not contain 'to_group'; assert dagJSON does not contain 'sentinel'; assert dagJSON contains 'relationship'

test_cases.description: DAG builder treats the sentinel field in tasks.json dependency entries as having no effect on edge construction or scheduling.
preconditions: tasks.json for spec '09' has two dependency entries: one with sentinel=true and one with sentinel=false, both depending on spec '07'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: dag_with_sentinel, _ = BuildDAG(ctx, ['07','09'], tasksReaderSentinelTrue); dag_without_sentinel, _ = BuildDAG(ctx, ['07','09'], tasksReaderSentinelFalse); assert len(dag_with_sentinel.Edges) == len(dag_without_sentinel.Edges); assert dag_with_sentinel.Edges[0].From == dag_without_sentinel.Edges[0].From

test_cases.description: Campaign scheduler creates a git branch named spec/<spec_id>-<spec_name> from integration branch HEAD for each frontier spec, records branch_name and branch_sha in campaign_specs, and sets spec status to active.
preconditions: Hub running with real git repo for workspace 'ws-slug'
Integration branch 'main' exists with HEAD SHA 'abc123'
Spec directory '07_secrets_variables' exists under .agent-fox/specs
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: campaign = createCampaign(ctx, {name: 'test', spec_ids: ['07'], integration_branch: 'main'}); spec = getSpecFromCampaign(campaign, '07'); assert spec.BranchName == 'spec/07-secrets-variables'; assert spec.BranchSHA == 'abc123'; assert spec.Status == 'active'; assert gitRunner.BranchExists('spec/07-secrets-variables') == true

test_cases.description: Spec branch name is derived deterministically from the spec directory name by converting the snake_case suffix of NN_snake_case_name to kebab-case.
preconditions: Spec directory name is '07_secrets_variables'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: branchName = DeriveSpecBranchName('07_secrets_variables'); assert branchName == 'spec/07-secrets-variables'

test_cases.description: POST /campaigns deletes all successfully created spec branches and returns an error without persisting any DB rows when any frontier spec branch fails to be created at the git level.
preconditions: Hub running with real git repo for workspace 'ws-slug'
Integration branch 'main' exists
Spec '07' branch creation succeeds but spec '08' branch creation fails (simulated git error)
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = client.post('/api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns', {name: 'sprint-42', spec_ids: ['07','08'], integration_branch: 'main'}); assert resp.status == 500; assert store.GetCampaignByName(ctx, 'ws-slug', 'sprint-42') == nil; assert gitRunner.BranchExists('spec/07-secrets-variables') == false

test_cases.description: POST /campaigns with spec_ids omitted scans tasks.json files at the workspace path and includes specs with at least one pending subtask.
preconditions: Hub running with workspace 'ws-slug' cloned at WORKSPACE_ROOT/ws-slug/trunk
Spec directory '07_secrets_variables' has tasks.json with one subtask with state=pending
Spec directory '08_other' has tasks.json with all subtasks state=done
Integration branch 'main' exists
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = client.post('/api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns', {name: 'implicit-camp', integration_branch: 'main'}); assert resp.status == 201; specIDs = [s.spec_id for s in resp.body.specs]; assert '07' in specIDs; assert '08' not in specIDs

test_cases.description: Implicit campaign discovery includes a spec only if its tasks.json contains at least one subtask with state equal to pending.
preconditions: tasks.json for spec '07' has subtasks: [{state: 'done'}, {state: 'pending'}]
tasks.json for spec '08' has subtasks: [{state: 'done'}, {state: 'done'}]
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: specs, warnings, err = DiscoverPendingSpecs(ctx, '/tmp/ws', 'ws-slug'); assert err == nil; assert '07' in specs; assert '08' not in specs

test_cases.description: PostMergeHook with DeadLetter=false acquires the per-campaign mutex, performs cascading rebase in topological order, advances the DAG frontier, checks completion, and releases the mutex.
preconditions: Campaign 'camp-1' with status=active exists
campaign_specs: spec '07' status=active (just merged), spec '09' status=active (depends on '07')
Real git repo with integration branch 'main' and spec branches for '09'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: hook = scheduler.PostMergeHook; hook(ctx, MergeJob{CampaignID: 'camp-1', SpecID: '07', DeadLetter: false}); spec07 = store.GetSpec(ctx, 'camp-1', '07'); assert spec07.Status == 'merged'; spec09 = store.GetSpec(ctx, 'camp-1', '09'); assert spec09.BranchSHA != originalSHA

test_cases.description: PostMergeHook is a no-op and returns immediately when invoked for a MergeJob with campaign_id equal to NULL.
preconditions: Campaign scheduler is initialized
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: callCount = 0; hook = scheduler.PostMergeHook; hook(ctx, MergeJob{CampaignID: '', SpecID: '07', DeadLetter: false}); assert store.MutationCallCount() == 0

test_cases.description: Campaign scheduler sets campaign status to completed when the last spec's merge is processed and all specs have status merged.
preconditions: Campaign 'camp-1' with status=active
campaign_specs: spec '07' status=active (being merged now), spec '08' status=merged
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: hook(ctx, MergeJob{CampaignID: 'camp-1', SpecID: '07', DeadLetter: false}); campaign = store.GetCampaign(ctx, 'camp-1'); assert campaign.Status == 'completed'

test_cases.description: PostMergeHook with DeadLetter=true sets spec status to failed, immediately sets campaign status to failed, releases the mutex, and returns without performing any rebase or frontier advancement.
preconditions: Campaign 'camp-1' with status=active
campaign_specs: spec '07' status=active, spec '08' status=active
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: rebaseCallCount = 0; hook(ctx, MergeJob{CampaignID: 'camp-1', SpecID: '07', DeadLetter: true}); spec07 = store.GetSpec(ctx, 'camp-1', '07'); assert spec07.Status == 'failed'; campaign = store.GetCampaign(ctx, 'camp-1'); assert campaign.Status == 'failed'; assert rebaseCallCount == 0

test_cases.description: Rebase engine rebases all active spec branches onto the new integration branch HEAD in topological DAG order (roots first, leaves last) after a successful merge.
preconditions: Real git repo with integration branch 'main'
Campaign 'camp-1' with DAG: '07' -> '09' (07 is root, 09 depends on 07)
Spec branches 'spec/07-secrets-variables' and 'spec/09-other' both exist and are active
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: rebaseOrder = []; hook(ctx, MergeJob{CampaignID: 'camp-1', SpecID: '05', DeadLetter: false}); assert rebaseOrder == ['07', '09']

test_cases.description: Rebase engine updates branch_sha in campaign_specs to the new HEAD SHA when a spec branch rebases cleanly.
preconditions: Real git repo with integration branch 'main' at SHA 'new-sha'
Spec branch 'spec/07-secrets-variables' exists with old SHA 'old-sha'
Campaign 'camp-1' with spec '07' status=active and branch_sha='old-sha'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: rebaseEngine.RebaseBranch(ctx, 'camp-1', '07', 'main'); spec07 = store.GetSpec(ctx, 'camp-1', '07'); assert spec07.BranchSHA != 'old-sha'; assert spec07.Status == 'active'

test_cases.description: Rebase engine sets spec status to blocked, revokes push access via PushAuthorizer, records conflicting file paths in conflict_details, records blocked_by_merge UUID, and skips downstream dependents when a spec branch has a rebase conflict.
preconditions: Real git repo with conflicting changes on integration branch 'main'
Campaign 'camp-1' with DAG: '07' -> '09'
Spec '07' branch has conflicting changes with 'main'
Spec '09' is active and depends on '07'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: rebaseEngine.CascadeRebase(ctx, 'camp-1', 'merge-uuid-1', 'main'); spec07 = store.GetSpec(ctx, 'camp-1', '07'); assert spec07.Status == 'blocked'; assert len(spec07.ConflictDetails) > 0; assert spec07.BlockedByMerge == 'merge-uuid-1'; assert pushAuthorizer.IsBlocked('spec/07-secrets-variables') == true; spec09 = store.GetSpec(ctx, 'camp-1', '09'); assert spec09.Status == 'active'

test_cases.description: Rebase engine applies conflict-stop semantics per branch subtree only — a conflict in one branch does not prevent rebasing of branches in unrelated parts of the DAG.
preconditions: Real git repo with integration branch 'main'
Campaign 'camp-1' with DAG: '07' -> '09' (subtree A), '08' standalone (subtree B)
Spec '07' branch conflicts with 'main'
Spec '08' branch rebases cleanly
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: rebaseEngine.CascadeRebase(ctx, 'camp-1', 'merge-uuid', 'main'); spec07 = store.GetSpec(ctx, 'camp-1', '07'); assert spec07.Status == 'blocked'; spec09 = store.GetSpec(ctx, 'camp-1', '09'); assert spec09.Status == 'active'; spec08 = store.GetSpec(ctx, 'camp-1', '08'); assert spec08.BranchSHA != originalSHA08

test_cases.description: Authz module registers a PushAuthorizer callback with internal/gitserver that rejects push attempts to a blocked spec branch.
preconditions: Campaign 'camp-1' with spec '07' status=blocked
PushAuthorizer registered with git server

expected.error_message: branch is blocked due to rebase conflict

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: err = pushAuthorizer(ctx, 'spec/07-secrets-variables'); assert err != nil; assert err.Error() contains 'blocked'

test_cases.description: PushAuthorizer rejects direct pushes to the integration branch, requiring all merges to go through the merge queue.
preconditions: Campaign 'camp-1' with integration_branch='main' is active
PushAuthorizer registered with git server

expected.error_message: direct pushes to integration branch are not allowed

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: err = pushAuthorizer(ctx, 'main'); assert err != nil; assert err.Error() contains 'integration branch'

test_cases.description: Authz module restores push access to a spec branch via PushAuthorizer when a blocked spec is successfully resolved and set back to active.
preconditions: Campaign 'camp-1' with spec '07' status=blocked
Push access revoked for 'spec/07-secrets-variables'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: authz.RestorePushAccess(ctx, 'spec/07-secrets-variables'); err = pushAuthorizer(ctx, 'spec/07-secrets-variables'); assert err == nil

test_cases.description: Resolve endpoint rebases spec branch onto current integration branch HEAD, restores push access, sets spec status to active, updates branch_sha, and returns HTTP 200 with spec_id, status=active, and branch_sha when spec is blocked and rebase is clean.
preconditions: Real git repo with integration branch 'main'
Campaign 'camp-1' with spec '07' status=blocked
Agent has resolved conflict locally; spec branch now rebases cleanly onto 'main'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = client.post('/api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns/camp-1/specs/07/resolve'); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body.spec_id == '07'; assert resp.body.status == 'active'; assert len(resp.body.branch_sha) == 40; spec07 = store.GetSpec(ctx, 'camp-1', '07'); assert spec07.Status == 'active'; assert pushAuthorizer.IsBlocked('spec/07-secrets-variables') == false

test_cases.description: Resolve endpoint returns HTTP 409 with updated conflict file list when spec is blocked and rebase still conflicts after agent's local fix.
preconditions: Real git repo with conflicting changes on 'main'
Campaign 'camp-1' with spec '07' status=blocked
Spec branch still conflicts with current 'main' HEAD
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = client.post('/api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns/camp-1/specs/07/resolve'); assert resp.status == 409; assert resp.body.conflict_details != nil; assert len(resp.body.conflict_details) > 0; spec07 = store.GetSpec(ctx, 'camp-1', '07'); assert spec07.Status == 'blocked'

test_cases.description: Resolve endpoint returns HTTP 200 with current status and branch_sha without performing any rebase when spec is already in active status.
preconditions: Campaign 'camp-1' with spec '07' status=active and branch_sha='abc123'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: rebaseCallCount = 0; resp = client.post('/api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns/camp-1/specs/07/resolve'); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body.status == 'active'; assert resp.body.branch_sha == 'abc123'; assert rebaseCallCount == 0

test_cases.description: Resolve endpoint returns HTTP 200 with current status=merged and branch_sha without performing any rebase when spec is already in merged status.
preconditions: Campaign 'camp-1' with spec '07' status=merged and branch_sha='def456'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: rebaseCallCount = 0; resp = client.post('/api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns/camp-1/specs/07/resolve'); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body.status == 'merged'; assert resp.body.branch_sha == 'def456'; assert rebaseCallCount == 0

test_cases.description: Resolve endpoint returns HTTP 409 with an error message when spec is in pending, failed, or cancelled status.
preconditions: Campaign 'camp-1' with spec '07' status=pending

body.error: spec is not in a resolvable state

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: for status in ['pending', 'failed', 'cancelled'] { store.SetSpecStatus(ctx, 'camp-1', '07', status); resp = client.post('/api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns/camp-1/specs/07/resolve'); assert resp.status == 409; assert resp.body.error contains 'state' }

test_cases.description: POST /campaigns computes the initial DAG frontier, creates spec branches, sets frontier specs to active, sets campaign to active, persists all rows, and returns HTTP 201 with the full campaign response.
preconditions: Hub running with real git repo for workspace 'ws-slug'
Integration branch 'main' exists
tasks.json for spec '07' has no dependencies and has pending subtasks
tasks.json for spec '09' depends on '07' and has pending subtasks

test_cases.description: Campaign creation response omits the warnings field or returns it as an empty array when no specs are skipped.
preconditions: All spec tasks.json files are valid and parseable
No specs are skipped during campaign creation

test_cases.description: GET /campaigns returns all campaigns for the workspace; when status query parameter is provided, only campaigns matching that status are returned.

test_cases.description: GET /campaigns returns HTTP 422 with a validation error when the status query parameter is provided with an invalid value.

campaign_specs: spec '07' status=cancelled
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: reason, err = canMerge(ctx, MergeJob{CampaignID: 'camp-1', SpecID: '07'}); assert err == nil; assert reason != ''; assert string(reason) contains 'cancel'

campaign_specs: spec '07' status=active

test_cases.description: Store module serializes the DAG as JSON with shape {specs, edges: [{from, to, relationship}]} into the dag TEXT column and deserializes it back to the same shape for API responses.
preconditions: SQLite in-memory DB initialized
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: dagJSON, err = SerializeDAG(dag); assert err == nil; assert dagJSON contains '"specs"'; assert dagJSON contains '"edges"'; assert dagJSON contains '"from"'; assert dagJSON contains '"relationship"'; deserialized, err2 = DeserializeDAG(dagJSON); assert err2 == nil; assert deserialized.Specs == ['07','09']; assert deserialized.Edges[0].From == '07'

test_cases.description: Store module serializes conflict_details as a JSON array of file path strings into campaign_specs.conflict_details TEXT column and deserializes it directly into the API response array.
preconditions: SQLite in-memory DB initialized with campaign_specs table
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: json, err = SerializeConflictDetails(['file1.go','file2.go']); assert err == nil; assert json == '["file1.go","file2.go"]'; deserialized, err2 = DeserializeConflictDetails(json); assert err2 == nil; assert deserialized == ['file1.go','file2.go']

test_cases.description: Campaign scheduler acquires an in-memory mutex from a sync.Map keyed by campaign ID before performing any state mutations in PostMergeHook, and releases it after all mutations complete.
preconditions: Campaign scheduler initialized with empty sync.Map
Campaign 'camp-1' with status=active
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mutexAcquiredAt = nil; mutexReleasedAt = nil; scheduler.OnMutexAcquire = func() { mutexAcquiredAt = now() }; scheduler.OnMutexRelease = func() { mutexReleasedAt = now() }; hook(ctx, MergeJob{CampaignID: 'camp-1', DeadLetter: false}); assert mutexAcquiredAt != nil; assert mutexReleasedAt != nil; assert mutexReleasedAt >= mutexAcquiredAt

test_cases.description: Campaign scheduler re-initializes the sync.Map as empty on hub restart; locks are re-acquired as PostMergeHook invocations arrive.
preconditions: Campaign scheduler was previously running with populated mutex map
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: scheduler = NewScheduler(ctx, store, gitRunner, pushAuthorizer); assert scheduler.MutexMapSize() == 0

property_tests.description: For any campaign in the campaigns table, the dag column when deserialized represents a directed acyclic graph with no cycles.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 50 random sets of 2-10 spec IDs with randomly generated dependency edges (using Go's math/rand seeded with test iteration); build the DAG via BuildDAG; only accept inputs where BuildDAG returns no error (i.e., acyclic inputs); persist to SQLite in-memory DB
property_tests.invariant_check: for each persisted campaign, deserialize dag column; run topological sort on the deserialized graph; assert topological sort succeeds (no cycle detected) and returns all spec IDs

property_tests.description: For any pair of (workspace_slug, integration_branch), at most one campaign with status=active exists at any time.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 20 random (workspace_slug, integration_branch) pairs; for each pair, attempt to create 2-5 campaigns concurrently via goroutines; use SQLite in-memory DB with real store
property_tests.invariant_check: after all creation attempts complete, query campaigns table for each (workspace_slug, integration_branch) pair; assert COUNT(*) WHERE status='active' <= 1

property_tests.description: For any pair of (workspace_slug, name), at most one campaign row exists regardless of status.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 30 random (workspace_slug, name) pairs; attempt to insert 2-3 campaigns with the same (workspace_slug, name) but different statuses into SQLite in-memory DB
property_tests.invariant_check: after all insertions, query campaigns table for each (workspace_slug, name) pair; assert COUNT(*) == 1 (only the first insertion succeeded)

property_tests.description: For any spec in campaign_specs where all upstream dependencies have status=merged, the spec has status=active, blocked, or merged — never pending once the campaign is active.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 20 random DAGs with 3-8 specs; simulate sequential merges of upstream specs using the real scheduler with SQLite in-memory DB; after each merge, check all specs whose upstream deps are all merged
property_tests.invariant_check: for each spec where all upstream deps have status=merged and campaign status=active, assert spec.Status in ['active', 'blocked', 'merged']

property_tests.description: For any campaign where any campaign_specs row has status=failed, the campaign's own status is also failed.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 20 random campaigns with 2-6 specs; randomly trigger dead-letter PostMergeHook for one spec; use real scheduler with SQLite in-memory DB
property_tests.invariant_check: after triggering dead-letter hook, query campaigns table; assert campaign.Status == 'failed' whenever any campaign_specs.status == 'failed'

property_tests.description: For any campaign_specs row with status=blocked, conflict_details is a non-null non-empty JSON array of file path strings and blocked_by_merge is a non-null UUID string.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 15 random rebase conflict scenarios using real git repos with conflicting changes; trigger cascading rebase via PostMergeHook; use real store with SQLite in-memory DB
property_tests.invariant_check: query all campaign_specs rows where status='blocked'; for each row, assert conflict_details IS NOT NULL; assert JSON parse of conflict_details yields non-empty array; assert blocked_by_merge IS NOT NULL and is a valid UUID string

property_tests.description: For any campaign with status=cancelled, every campaign_specs row for that campaign also has status=cancelled.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 20 random campaigns with 2-8 specs in various statuses (active, blocked, pending); cancel each via DELETE endpoint; use real store with SQLite in-memory DB
property_tests.invariant_check: after cancellation, query campaign_specs WHERE campaign_id = cancelled_campaign_id; assert all rows have status='cancelled'

property_tests.description: For any POST /campaigns request that returns a non-201 response, no campaigns row and no campaign_specs rows are persisted, and no spec branches created during the request remain in the git repository.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 15 failure scenarios: duplicate name, duplicate active campaign, invalid integration branch, git branch creation failure (injected at random spec index); use real git repo and SQLite in-memory DB
property_tests.invariant_check: after each failed POST, assert campaigns table has no new row; assert campaign_specs table has no new rows; assert git repo has no new branches matching 'spec/*' pattern created during the request

property_tests.description: For any POST resolve call on a spec with status=active or status=merged, the response is HTTP 200 with the current status and branch_sha, and no rebase is performed.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 20 random (campaign, spec) pairs where spec status is active or merged; call resolve endpoint; use real store with SQLite in-memory DB and mock GitRunner that records rebase calls
property_tests.invariant_check: assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body.status in ['active', 'merged']; assert resp.body.branch_sha == spec.BranchSHA before call; assert gitRunner.RebaseCallCount() == 0

property_tests.description: For any cascading rebase where spec A conflicts and spec B is in an unrelated DAG subtree, spec B is rebased regardless of spec A's conflict.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 20 random DAGs with at least 2 independent subtrees (no shared ancestors); inject conflict for a random spec in subtree A; run cascading rebase with real git repos
property_tests.invariant_check: after cascade, for each spec in subtree B (unrelated to conflicting spec A), assert spec.BranchSHA has been updated (rebase occurred); assert spec.Status != 'blocked'

property_tests.description: For any campaign with status=completed, every campaign_specs row for that campaign has status=merged.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 15 random campaigns with 2-6 specs; simulate sequential merges of all specs via PostMergeHook with DeadLetter=false; use real scheduler with SQLite in-memory DB
property_tests.invariant_check: when campaign.Status == 'completed', query all campaign_specs for that campaign; assert every row has status='merged'

Go test run with -race flag enabled

edge_case_tests.description: On hub restart after a mid-hook crash, the scheduler recomputes the frontier from current campaign_specs status rows in the DB; the next PostMergeHook invocation heals any partial cascade.

preconditions: Campaign 'camp-1' with status=completed

body.error: campaign cannot be cancelled in its current state

edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: for status in ['completed', 'failed'] { store.SetCampaignStatus(ctx, 'camp-1', status); resp = client.delete('/api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns/camp-1'); assert resp.status == 409; assert resp.body.error contains 'cancel' }

edge_case_tests.description: DELETE /campaigns/:id returns HTTP 500 and rolls back the transaction so campaign and all specs remain in their previous state when the DB update to set campaign_specs statuses to cancelled fails partway through.
preconditions: Campaign 'camp-1' with status=active
Mock store that fails on UpdateAllSpecStatuses after updating the first spec
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: resp = client.delete('/api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns/camp-1'); assert resp.status == 500; campaign = store.GetCampaign(ctx, 'camp-1'); assert campaign.Status == 'active'; specs = store.GetCampaignSpecs(ctx, 'camp-1'); for spec in specs { assert spec.Status != 'cancelled' }

edge_case_tests.description: Campaign scheduler fails startup with a clear error message and non-zero exit code when the DB is unavailable during hub restart.
preconditions: SQLite DB file is inaccessible or corrupted
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: store, err = NewStore(unavailableDB); assert err != nil; assert err.Error() contains 'database'

edge_case_tests.description: Store module returns a non-nil error to the caller without panicking or calling os.Exit when schema initialization SQL fails due to a read-only DB.
preconditions: SQLite DB file opened in read-only mode
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: store, err = NewStore(readOnlyDB); assert err != nil; assert err.Error() contains 'read-only' or err.Error() contains 'CREATE TABLE'

edge_case_tests.description: Store module returns a non-nil error to the caller when the dag column contains malformed JSON when reading from the DB.
preconditions: SQLite in-memory DB with campaigns table
Campaign row with dag column set to 'not-valid-json'
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: db.Exec("UPDATE campaigns SET dag = 'not-valid-json' WHERE id = 'camp-1'"); campaign, err = store.GetCampaign(ctx, 'camp-1'); assert err != nil; assert campaign == nil

edge_case_tests.description: Store module returns a non-nil error to the caller when the conflict_details column contains malformed JSON when reading from the DB.
preconditions: SQLite in-memory DB with campaign_specs table
campaign_specs row with conflict_details set to 'not-valid-json'
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: db.Exec("UPDATE campaign_specs SET conflict_details = 'not-valid-json' WHERE campaign_id = 'camp-1' AND spec_id = '07'"); spec, err = store.GetSpec(ctx, 'camp-1', '07'); assert err != nil; assert spec == nil

edge_case_tests.description: Campaign scheduler recovers from a panic in a PostMergeHook goroutine while holding the per-campaign mutex, releases the mutex, logs the panic, and sets campaign status to failed.
preconditions: Campaign 'camp-1' with status=active
Mock hook implementation that panics after acquiring the mutex
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: logOutput = captureLog(); mutexReleased = false; scheduler.OnMutexRelease = func() { mutexReleased = true }; scheduler.InjectPanic('camp-1'); hook(ctx, MergeJob{CampaignID: 'camp-1', SpecID: '07', DeadLetter: false}); assert mutexReleased == true; assert logOutput contains 'panic'; campaign = store.GetCampaign(ctx, 'camp-1'); assert campaign.Status == 'failed'

smoke_tests.description: Explicit campaign creation synchronously activates the campaign, creates frontier spec branches, and returns HTTP 201 with status=active before the response is sent.
smoke_tests.trigger: Send POST /api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns with name='sprint-42', spec_ids=['07','09'], integration_branch='main'
expected_effects: HTTP 201 response with body containing status='active', id (UUID), dag with specs=['07','09'] and edges=[{from:'07',to:'09'}], specs array with spec '07' status='active' and branch_name='spec/07-secrets-variables', spec '09' status='pending'
Git branch 'spec/07-secrets-variables' exists in the workspace repo
campaigns table has one row with status='active' and name='sprint-42'
campaign_specs table has two rows: spec '07' status='active' with branch_sha set, spec '09' status='pending'

smoke_tests.description: Successful merge triggers cascading rebase of sibling branches in topological order, advances the DAG frontier by creating branches for newly-unblocked specs, and sets campaign to completed when all specs are merged.
smoke_tests.trigger: Invoke PostMergeHook with MergeJob{CampaignID:'camp-1', SpecID:'07', DeadLetter:false} for a campaign with DAG '07'->'09'
expected_effects: campaign_specs row for spec '07' has status='merged'
campaign_specs row for spec '09' has updated branch_sha (rebased) or status='blocked' if conflict
Git branch 'spec/09-other' created if '09' was previously pending and is now unblocked
campaign_specs row for spec '09' has status='active' if it was unblocked
campaigns row has status='completed' if '09' was the last spec and also merged

smoke_tests.description: Dead-letter merge job triggers immediate campaign failure: spec status set to failed, campaign status set to failed, no rebase or frontier advancement performed.
smoke_tests.trigger: Invoke PostMergeHook with MergeJob{CampaignID:'camp-1', SpecID:'07', DeadLetter:true}
expected_effects: campaign_specs row for spec '07' has status='failed'
campaigns row for 'camp-1' has status='failed'
No rebase operations performed (GitRunner rebase not called)
No new spec branches created
GET /api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns/camp-1 returns status='failed'

smoke_tests.description: Agent resolves a blocked spec branch conflict: resolve endpoint rebases onto current integration HEAD, restores push access, sets spec to active, and returns HTTP 200 with new branch_sha.
smoke_tests.trigger: Send POST /api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns/camp-1/specs/07/resolve after agent has resolved conflict locally
expected_effects: HTTP 200 response with body {spec_id:'07', status:'active', branch_sha:<40-char-hex>}
campaign_specs row for spec '07' has status='active' and updated branch_sha
Push access restored for branch 'spec/07-secrets-variables' (PushAuthorizer no longer rejects pushes)
conflict_details and blocked_by_merge cleared in campaign_specs row

smoke_tests.description: Campaign cancellation sets campaign and all spec statuses to cancelled, leaves spec branches in place, and causes CanMerge to reject any pending merge jobs for cancelled specs.
smoke_tests.trigger: Send DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns/camp-1 for an active campaign
expected_effects: HTTP 200 response with body reflecting campaign status='cancelled' and all spec statuses='cancelled'
campaigns table row has status='cancelled'
All campaign_specs rows have status='cancelled'
Git branch 'spec/07-secrets-variables' still exists in the repo (not deleted)
CanMerge called for spec '07' returns non-nil CantMergeReason containing 'cancel'

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end implicit campaign creation through merge completion: hub discovers pending specs, creates campaign, agents work on branches, merges complete, campaign reaches completed status.
smoke_tests.trigger: Send POST /api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns with only name='e2e-camp' and integration_branch='main' (no spec_ids); then simulate full merge cycle
expected_effects: HTTP 201 response with status='active', specs array containing only specs with pending subtasks, warnings array for any skipped specs
GET /api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns?status=active returns the new campaign
After all spec merges via PostMergeHook, GET /api/v1/workspaces/ws-slug/campaigns/camp-id returns status='completed'
All campaign_specs rows have status='merged'
No spec branches deleted (left in place)
